canada.title: New AI app helps Montreal woman with ALS get her voice back
canada.summary: Anne-Marie Poirier has amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS, a progressive neurological disease that has robbed her of her ability to speak and affected her ability to swallow. canada.summary: To be eligible for legal aid, an individual can't make more than $27,000 per year. A private family lawyer can cost someone hundreds of dollars per hour. Compounding the problem could be the territory’s lawyer shortage, which is hitting family law particularly hard.

Several streets in Winnipeg will see traffic closures for the Santa Claus Parade on Saturday, CityNews Winnipeg reports.
All 197 passengers and crew on the American Heritage cruise ship survived Friday as well as the crew on the tanker, The Associated Press reports.
Thousands of flights canceled as airlines work to recover from nationwide ground stop, PBS NewsHour reports.
